original_paper.title: A long-tailed distribution time-series dataset in boiler equipment
facts: coal-fired industrial boiler at a chemical plant in Zhejiang, China
data collected from 2022-03-27 to 2022-04-01 at 5 s intervals
boiler outlet steam temperature 530-545 °C is reported as the normal range

materialized_source.title: CFB Boiler Synthetic Fault Dataset
materialized_source.selection: rows 0-19 from the dataset viewer; the dataset card states rows 0-599 are real operational data and rows 600-1319 are synthetic fault injection
materialized_source.note: Only the real, label=normal prefix is materialized here. No injected-fault rows are included.

supported: physical plausibility checks for O2, pressure, temperature and steam flow
import of a public real-data slice into the EULER diary schema after explicit conversion
not_supported: full fuel-to-steam efficiency validation because this public slice has no fuel mass/PCI/moisture and no feedwater temperature
stack-loss calculation because O2 and flue-gas temperature are published at different economizer locations in the source metadata
